text_block_list.text:
Second half of Summer Training Camp underway. 
Duramente drilling hard for autumn debut race.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ——Hah!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Flawless form……even across deep sand. 
Elite pedigree shows in every stride.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Focused squarely on autumn debut…… 
Training output bound to show remarkable results.

Word spread of "Duramente's Summer Camp," 
drawing fans, reporters, academy peers. Yet——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Haa——! ……Fuu————
——Again.

Utterly composed through reps. 
Ignored crowd, maintained razor focus.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa……!
choice_data_list: OK, your lap running is consistent!

text_block_list.text:
Just like this, lately she's been able to concentrate 
without being affected by the pressure. It was a good sign.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haa——!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ——……Ready.
choice_data_list: Looking good. We'll time it next
Looking good. We'll time it next

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Understood. From that mark over there——

text_block_list.name: Spectating Fan
text_block_list.text: Oh! Timing Duramente's run!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Phew—……
choice_data_list: Dura! Are you ready?
Dura! Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Spectating Fan
text_block_list.text:
Bet sand feels no different than turf to her! 
She's Duramente, after all——!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (……Focus. Eyes only on goal where Trainer stands.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Inhale—……Exhale——……
……——
choice_data_list: Ready……Start!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haaaa……!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Incredible burst! On heavy sand?! 
Unreal speed……——
choice_data_list: Goal!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……Haa, haa……Phew.
choice_data_list: Awesome! Your best time!
Awesome! Your best time!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
——! 
……I see. Another rep.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
——Tenth run! 
Time?

Off personal best by just 0.2 seconds. 
Confirmed pacing remains remarkably consistent.
choice_data_list: Let's call it a day, good work!
Let's call it a day, good work!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Right. 
……Interview scheduled next.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Meeting father at nearby cafe, 5 PM sharp. 
30 minutes……Trainer, can you make it?

With father present, likely family affair. 
Recalled her saying not to worry about family business, but——
choice_data_list: Is it okay to tag along?
Is it okay to tag along?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Eh?
choice_data_list: Huh? It's family-related right?
Huh? It's family-related right?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Offer made through family line. 
No obligation for you to attend.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (——Correct. Family matter. Trainer holds no role here……——)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (Since when……did I begin expecting……?)
choice_data_list: ……Something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No……not involved. 
If busy, do not force yourself.
choice_data_list: Would I be intruding……?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Not burdening. Rather—— 
…………Apologies. Unconsciously assumed you would accompany me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: At some point……began taking your presence for granted——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Looking back…… 
Product launch event.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Support when tension struck at gym. 
Track drills earlier today——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……Grown accustomed to reassurance your presence brings.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: That is why, without realizing it, I... And now I see how much I have relied on you. I apologize——
choice_data_list: If that's how you feel, I'll go with you
If that's how you feel, I'll go with you

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: If that helps you stay calm, even more so
If that helps you stay calm, even more so

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Then, I would like you to accompany me.
The subsequent interview went smoothly in a relaxed atmosphere——
By the time everything wrapped up, darkness had completely fallen.
She had to be exhausted after training and the interview. I suggested we take a break here.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: The stars are wonderful, aren't they?
The stars are wonderful, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (It brings such peace... Far more than any quiet sanctuary, or time spent alone, more than anything else...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Being near this person grants me composure.
...It makes me stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ............You truly are an enigmatic person.
